principle: A genre is a governed space of musical morphology: structural behavior, embodied gesture, instrument interaction, articulation, harmony, and production. Notes are the realization layer, not the starting unit.

blend_policy.conflict_resolution: Declare which grammar owns each layer; reject unresolved contradictions rather than blending numeric presets.

keys: optional cold drone or choir-like color

gestures.TRANCE: long tremolo repetition that transforms incrementally
gestures.SPRINT: continuous forward rush with a distinct riff identity
gestures.COLLAPSE: energy falls away to a low dissonant remnant
gestures.RELEASE: dissolve into sustain, noise, or unresolved space

synthwave.label: Synthwave
production: bright transient over dark harmonic bed

gestures.GLOW: wide chord field opens around a motif
gestures.ASCENT: register and filter rise toward arrival
gestures.ORBIT: arpeggio circles a stable harmonic bed
gestures.RELEASE: beat falls away into a long tail

jazz_fusion.label: Jazz synth fusion
production: effects support timbre without masking interaction

gestures.GLIDE: motif enters through long tones and widening register
gestures.LOCK: bass, drums, and comping interlock around a pocket
gestures.FRACTURE: displaced accents and rests break the pocket
gestures.ORBIT: motif develops while groove remains grounded
gestures.LIFT: register and ensemble density rise toward arrival
gestures.RELEASE: activity falls and harmonic tension resolves or hangs

gestures.INTRODUCE: establish riff, pulse, and tonal center
gestures.VERSE: leave space for narrative and build
gestures.HOOK: motif opens in register and ensemble weight
gestures.BRIDGE: reframe harmony, rhythm, or point of view
gestures.RELEASE: resolve, ring out, or cut away

harmony.center: modal, suspended, drone, or slowly shifting

gestures.DRIFT: establish a slowly changing sound field
gestures.BLOOM: harmonic and spectral components enter gradually
gestures.SUSPEND: hold unresolved tones and allow duration to carry form
gestures.TRANSFORM: change timbre, voicing, register, or spatial position without forcing a new section
gestures.THIN: remove layers until one trace remains
gestures.SETTLE: fade or resolve into a stable field

acceptance_requirements.reason: ambient plan need not impose a conventional beat
